title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Measures for Payment of Litigation Costs
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Measures on Payment of Litigation Costs

Fa Fa [2007] No. 16

All local people's courts at various levels nationwide, all military courts at various levels, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, all maritime courts, and all courts at various levels of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

The Measures on Payment of Litigation Costs (hereinafter referred to as the "Measures") came into effect on April 1, 2007. The Measures on Litigation Fees of People's Courts and the Supplementary Provisions to the Measures on Litigation Fees of People's Courts promulgated by the Supreme People's Court shall no longer apply simultaneously. In order to implement the Measures and standardize the payment and management of litigation costs, the relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. Concerning the Transition of Fee Collection after the Implementation of the Measures

For litigation cases and enforcement cases accepted by the people's courts after April 1, 2007, the provisions of the Measures shall apply.

For litigation cases and enforcement cases accepted by the people's courts before April 1, 2007, the provisions of the Measures shall not apply.

For cases in which a legally effective judgment or ruling made before April 1, 2007 is lawfully retried, the provisions of the Measures shall apply. Where the people's court makes a revised judgment in a retrial case in accordance with the law, the allocation of original litigation costs shall be re-determined according to the principles and standards for allocating litigation costs at the time of the original trial.

2. Concerning the Consequences of a Party's Failure to Pay the Case Acceptance Fee or Application Fee as Prescribed

If a party fails to pay the case acceptance fee or application fee within the time limit as prescribed in Article 20 of the Measures without applying for judicial assistance, or if the application for judicial assistance is not approved and the party still fails to pay the case acceptance fee or application fee within the time limit designated by the people's court, the people's court shall, in accordance with the law, treat the matter as the party's voluntary withdrawal of the action or withdrawal of the application.

3. Concerning the Allocation of Litigation Costs

Article 29 of the Measures provides that litigation costs shall be borne by the losing party, unless the prevailing party voluntarily bears them. In cases where the plaintiff prevails, the litigation costs shall be borne by the defendant. The people's court shall refund the prepaid litigation costs to the plaintiff, and then directly collect them from the defendant, unless the plaintiff voluntarily bears the costs or agrees to the defendant paying them directly to the plaintiff.

If a party refuses to pay litigation costs, the people's court shall, in accordance with the law, enforce payment by compulsory measures.

4. Concerning the Collection of Enforcement Application Fees and Bankruptcy Application Fees

Article 20 of the Measures provides that enforcement application fees and bankruptcy application fees shall not be prepaid by the applicant. The enforcement application fee shall be paid after enforcement, and the bankruptcy application fee shall be paid after liquidation. As of April 1, 2007, the enforcement application fee shall be directly collected by the people's court from the person subject to enforcement in addition to the content determined by the effective legal instrument. The bankruptcy application fee shall be paid by the people's court from the bankruptcy property as a priority after the bankruptcy liquidation.

5. Concerning the Application and Approval Procedures for Judicial Assistance

The Measures provide for the principles, forms, and procedures of judicial assistance, but do not provide for the application and approval procedures for judicial assistance. To standardize the operational procedures of the people's courts regarding judicial assistance, the Supreme People's Court will shortly revise the Provisions on Providing Judicial Assistance to Parties Who Truly Have Financial Difficulties and promptly promulgate and implement them in courts nationwide.

6. Concerning the Specific Payment Standards for Case Acceptance Fees and Application Fees in Various Provinces, Autonomous Regions, and Municipalities Directly under the Central Government

The Measures authorize the people's governments of various provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government to formulate, in light of local actual conditions, specific payment standards for case acceptance fees and application fees within the ranges provided for in Article 13, items (2), (3), and (6) and Article 14, item (1). Each higher people's court shall consult with the people's government at the same level to promptly formulate the specific payment standards for case acceptance fees and application fees in the respective province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government in accordance with the above provisions, and shall promptly issue them to the courts under its jurisdiction for implementation.

April 20, 2007
